sql:
SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, SUM(yt) as total_yt, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boat_count
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 145
GROUP BY fish_date_doy 
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10
